exposure: Prolonged second stage (≥2 h) of labor
cohort: 667 women with term, singleton births at a large regional hospital in Australia between April 2017 and March 2019, with a third trimester ultrasound.
finding: Sonographic fetal head circumference was not associated with OASIS but was associated with mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a sonographic fetal head circumference ≥ 90th percentile had 2.77 times higher odds of having a caesarean section compared to a spontaneous vaginal birth than those with a head circumference < 90th percentile.
